posts.cooked:
Cosmic Delivery? - ROUND 1 - Voss-In-The-Box

Villain Turn (Voss on Conquering Alien Warlord side)
Start -
  5 minions in play; GW Voss does not flip; GW Voss does not auto-win

Play - Gene-Bound Ion-Lancer (B) [3]

End -
 - Ion-Lancer (A) deals 2 energy damage to Tempest [24]
 - Frosthound deals 2 cold damage to Ra [28], Naturalist [27], Mr Fixer [26], Nightmist [25], Tempest [22]
 - Shock Infantry deals 3 lightning damage to Ra [25]
 - Soldier deals 2 projectile damage to Naturalist [25]
 - Ion-Lancer (B) deals 2 energy damage to Tempest [20]

=======
Effects:
- Increase damage dealt by GW Voss to Tempest by 1 (Nemesis)
- Increase damage dealt by Tempest to GW Voss by 1 (Nemesis)
- Decrease damage done by hereos by 1  (Conquering Alien Warlord - Advanced)
- Reduce damage to GW Voss by 2 for each minion in play. (Conquering Alien Warlord)

- At the start of the villain turn if there are 10 or more minions in play the plantet has been overrun by the Thorathian Army.  Game Over.  No Wrath of the Cosmos for you! (Conquering Alien Warlord)
- At the start of the villain turn if there are no minions in play, flip GW Voss' character cards (Conquering Alien Warlord)

- At the end of the villain turn, Ion-Lancer deals the hero target with the lowest HP 2 Energy damage (GB Ion-Lancer)
- At the end of the villain turn, Frosthound deals each hero target 2 cold damage (GB Frosthound)
- Reduce damage dealt to villain targets by 1 (GB Guard)
- At the end of the villain turn, Shock Infantry deals the hero target with the highest HP 3 lightning damage (GB Shock Infantry)
- At the end of the villain turn, Soldier deals the hero target with the highest HP 2 projectile damage (GB Soldier)


Status
======
GW Voss [90] (Conquering Alien Warlord) (-13)
Gene-Bound Ion-Lancer (A) [3] (-1; immune to energy)
Gene-Bound Frosthound [3] (-1; immune to cold)
Gene-Bound Guard [3]  (-1)
Gene-Bound Shock Infantry [3] (-1; immune to lightning)
Gene-Bound Soldier [3] (-1; immune to projectile)
Gene-Bound Ion-Lancer (B) [3] (-1; immune to energy)

Villain Trash: empty

-------(Hero damage dealt is decreased by 1)
Ra          [25]  
Naturalist  [25]
Mr Fixer    [26] (high HP)
Nightmist   [25]
Tempest     [20] (low HP)

------- Envr


Comments:
Voss' minion greet the arriving heroes with a barrage of energy bolts, bullets, and elemental blasts.  Voss himself stands in the back chuckling while he slowly tears a Santa hat in half.

Standard Round 1 unloading on the heroes.

posts.cooked: Yes and no.   Advanced Voss on this doesn't add DR.   He simply reduces damage dealt by heroes.  So if you an ability that damages yourself or if you tried to attack an environment target that damage is reduced by one.   It's affects any attacks compared to normal DR
